title: Cross-Surface V1.1 Hardening Artifact
description: Schema-governed artifact that records the closure status of all 5 P0 cross-surface hardening seams from the v1 convergence review. Records roundtrip test results, shared refusal vocabulary status, provider/CI trace joinability, MCP runtime refusal adapter coverage, and ACP stub-to-schema refusal adapter coverage. Content-light: no raw tokens, paths, secrets, prompts, or private file contents.
